title: The Way of the Righteous and the Wicked

questions.question: What does the blessed man not do?
options: Walk in the counsel of the wicked
questions.correctAnswer: Walk in the counsel of the wicked
questions.explanation: Psalm 1:1 (ESV): "Blessed is the man who walks not in the counsel of the wicked, nor stands in the way of sinners, nor sits in the seat of scoffers;"

questions.question: What is the delight of the blessed man?
questions.explanation: Psalm 1:2 (ESV): "but his delight is in the law of the Lord, and on his law he meditates day and night."

questions.question: He is like a tree planted by what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 1:3 (ESV): "He is like a tree planted by streams of water that yields its fruit in its season..."

questions.question: What are the wicked like?
options: Chaff that the wind drives away
questions.correctAnswer: Chaff that the wind drives away
questions.explanation: Psalm 1:4 (ESV): "The wicked are not so, but are like chaff that the wind drives away."

questions.question: Who will not stand in the judgment?
questions.explanation: Psalm 1:5 (ESV): "Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous;"

questions.question: When does the blessed man meditate on the law?
questions.explanation: Psalm 1:2 (ESV): "...and on his law he meditates day and night."

questions.question: What does the tree yield in its season?
questions.explanation: Psalm 1:3 (ESV): "...that yields its fruit in its season..."

questions.question: What happens to the leaf of the tree?
questions.explanation: Psalm 1:3 (ESV): "...and its leaf does not wither. In all that he does, he prospers."

questions.question: Who knows the way of the righteous?
questions.explanation: Psalm 1:6 (ESV): "for the Lord knows the way of the righteous..."

questions.question: What will happen to the way of the wicked?
questions.explanation: Psalm 1:6 (ESV): "...but the way of the wicked will perish."

questions.question: The wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 1:5 (ESV): "...nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous;"

questions.question: In all that he does, he does what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 1:3 (ESV): "In all that he does, he prospers."

questions.question: The blessed man does not sit in the seat of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 1:1 (ESV): "...nor sits in the seat of scoffers;"

questions.question: The blessed man does not stand in the way of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 1:1 (ESV): "...nor stands in the way of sinners..."

questions.question: How many verses are in Psalm 1?

key_verse_text: Blessed is the man who walks not in the counsel of the wicked... but his delight is in the law of the Lord.
